notes.title: v0.4.1
notes.content:
Issues fixed:
* Fixed bug where some quest rewards lacked item type.
* Fixed bug where some doors wouldn't open the first time.

notes.title: v0.4.0
notes.content:
New content:
* Level cap raised to 25.
* Seren Virelith quest line continues.
* Head to the Royal Garden Tavern to pick up a quest leading north of Valoris.
* Talents, crafting recipes, enchants, world drops, quests, and more.
Changes:
* Direct damage and heals from spells and abilities will usually be slightly randomized.
* Witch spell Elemental Destruction unlocks at level 10.
Issues fixed:
* Fixed bug where spells and abilities didn't scale enough after level 20.

notes.title: v0.3.4
notes.content:
Issues fixed:
* Fixed crash when dragging equipped item to empty inventory or stash slot.
* Fixed bug where Demonic Spawn in Tower of Voraghul would despawn immediately.
* Fixed bug where the quest Chasing Voraghul couldn't be completed.
* Fixed bug where last tick from damage-over-time and heal-over-time spells didn't resolve.

notes.title: v0.3.3
notes.content:
Changes:
* New custom server and offline modes available.
* Custom server binaries available in install directory.
* Realm modifier: hardcore mode (only available in custom server and offline modes).
Issues fixed:
* Fixed item stat budget bug. Most items will have more stats now.

notes.title: v0.3.2
notes.content:
Issues fixed:	
* Angered Temple Spirits can now drop Spirit Dust and Ectoplasm.
* Runecore Sentinel achievement now triggers like intended.
* Karthul Blackfang now drops Token of Victory like intended.
* Bloodied Rope drop from Skaldrak now has correct item type.
* Fixed bug where map would be displayed incorrectly in Gateway worlds.
* Fixed a couple of crash bugs.
* Fixed a bug that allowed equipping binds-on-equip items without binding them.
* Fixed a bug that prevented stash UI updating correctly under some circumstances.

notes.title: v0.3.1
notes.content:
Changes:	
* Enemies spawning during Bone Tyrant and Malrik the Undying fights are no longer elite.
Issues fixed:
* Northern gates of Durgan Urok are now open like intended.
* Item tool tip background slightly darker to make it easier to read.

notes.title: v0.3.0
notes.content:
New content:
* Level cap raised to 22.	
* Zones: Skaldrun and Xandralis.
* Dungeon: Durgan Urok.
* Crafting recipes, enchants, world drops, quests, and more.
Changes:
* Blocking now has a base damage reduction of 30%, increased by block value.
* Item budget cost of block chance reduced.
Issues fixed:
* Fixed bug that could prevent quest indicators over NPCs from appearing correctly.
* Fixed bug that could break enchants when dying.

notes.title: v0.2.10
notes.content:
Changes:
* Irza and Draethor the Beholder got new abilities.
Issues fixed:
* Fixed client crash caused by talents UI.
* Some server stability issues fixed.

notes.title: v0.2.9
notes.content:
Issues fixed:
* Possible fix of bug where you'd die right after transfering to another map.
* Fixed bug that would happen whenever someone fished.

notes.title: v0.2.8
notes.content:
Issues fixed:
* A server stability issue is being investigated.

notes.title: v0.2.7
notes.content:
Changes:
* Increased bonuses from Pickled Toesnapper, Steamed Trout, Seared Bass, Spicy Perch Fillet, and Mistveil Balls.
* Cloth (except capes), mail armor, and two-handed weapons can no longer give block value or block chance bonuses.
* Two-handed swords, maces, and axes can no longer give caster bonuses.
Issues fixed:
* Removed extra Spirit Stone from Durgan Tharok.
* Fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: v0.2.6
notes.content:
Changes:
* Added option to disable FPS throttling for smoother graphics.
* Added option to switch between Direct3D 9, Direct3D 11, and OpenGL rendering.
* Opening chests, picking herbs, etc, will now break stealth.
Issues fixed:
* FPS should be higher in general.
* Fixed bug where the quest Elderwood Mushrooms would disappear from NPC dialogue.

notes.title: v0.2.5
notes.content:
Changes:
* Increased item level of loot from Zyxtharion and Eldros the Evergrowing.
* Ferocity can now stack to a maximum of 5.
* Ferocity is now a single point talent. All fighters have had their talent points reset.
* Bash threat bonus increased from 50% to 100%.
* The following buffs and debuffs are now unique per caster: Banner of Command, Poison Bomb, Envenom, Rend, Intervention of Wrath, Cleanse, Creeping Guilt, Condemnation, Blessing, Curse of Corruption, and Soul Leak.
* Threat meter can be enabled by right-clicking in combat log.
* Crocodiles can now drop Menacing Jaws.
* Infected Deer and Infected Boars can now also drop deer and boar items.
Issues fixed:
* Quest rewards from Sheila Urkins now have armor (thanks sithpl).
* Fixed bug that caused dead escort NPCs to take too long to respawn.
* Ranks 4 and 5 of Improved Soul Leak and Improved Curse of Corruption should now work like intended.
* Having the same enchant on both weapons while dual wielding now works like intended.

notes.title: v0.2.4
notes.content:
Changes:
* Escorted NPCs will stop walking while the player is in combat.
* New world map (still no scrolling, sorry).
* Intervention of Wrath, Spiritual Surge, Overpower, Elemental Infusion, and Maliciousness are no longer on the global cooldown (thanks sithpl).
* Jewelry can now be disenchanted.
* Mounting and dismounting is no longer on the global cooldown.
* Dungeon bosses now reset their Token of Victory cooldown at the same time for everyone.
* /roll gives a random number between 1 and 100. /roll X between 1 and X. /roll X-Y between X and Y.
* New enchants for cloaks.
Issues fixed:
* Fixed bug where certain quest objectives, like escorting an NPC, wouldn't be triggered for all group members.
* Several fixes by sithpl: Spiritual Surge no longer melee range only, Gash Hewitt's Cloak now has armor, and the quest The Best Deal Ever works again.
* More consistent enchanting reagent icons.
* Fixed wrong icons on a lot of items.

notes.title: v0.2.3
notes.content:
Changes:
* Black Beast's Growl ability now increases threat by 100% instead of 50%.
* Melee enemies can now push less dangerous enemies out of their way to get to their target.
* Holy Reflection now generates more threat and will also trigger on blocks (thanks sithpl).
* Tirnwood Thorns now binds when picked up.
* Non-boss enemy health levels reduced slightly in Valoris Insurgency, Tower of Indulath, and Tirnwood Thicket.
* Priests have figured out how to use one-handed maces.
Issues fixed:
* Natural Remedy now works like intended.
* Witch talent Improved Drain Life now works like intended.
* Fixed bug that caused some passive talents and auras to malfunction after logging out.
* Minions now work in The Shrouded Lands.
* Fixed missing food buffs, item types and some wrong icons (also thanks sithpl).
* The quest Delivery to the City can now be turned in at Mathew's Emporium.
* Robe of the Soulsplitter is now made of cloth like intended.

notes.title: v0.2.2
notes.content:
New:
* Completed quests show up on the map.
* Two new enchants for chest armor.
Issues fixed:	
* Removed extra spirit stones.
* Added missing stashes.
* Increased the distance you can get from escorted NPC before despawn.
* Fishing available in all of The Shrouded Lands like intended.
* Items that increase critical strike chance with spells now work correctly.
* Fixed some minor bugs.
* Elite guards in The Shrouded Lands can no longer be pushed around.
* Some elites can no longer be easily kited far away from their original location.
* Reagents for certain enchants changed to be more level appropriate.
* Quest list is now scrollable.

notes.title: v0.2.1
notes.content:
Changes:	
* Guards in Valoris can now help you find things.
Issues fixed:	
* Herbalism and mining in Thalvaron now works like intended.
* Recently added food items no longer consume entire stack when eaten.
* Fixed bug where you couldn't loot chests while in a party.

notes.title: v0.2.0
notes.content:
New content:
* Level cap raised to 20.
* Tons of new quests, zones, dungeons, talents, minions, and a lot more.
* New professions: enchanting and tailoring.
Changes:
* All talent points have been reset due to talent tree changes.
* Buffs can be canceled by right clicking.
* Real-time and historical fight details (damage per second, etc) can be accessed by right clicking in combat log.
* A new quest tracking interface can be enabled in the quest log.
* Two new equipment slots for trinkets.
* Fixed bug that allowed paladins to spam Divine Shield.
* Fixed bug where you couldn't use right-click to move items from inventory to stash.

notes.title: v0.1.20
notes.content:
Changes:
* Damage from Dragon Breath increased. Now scales with Attack Power instead of Spell Damage.
* Damage from Poison Bomb reduced.
* The attack damage of level 1 to 12 enemies reduced to roughly what it was before previous patch.
Issues fixed:	
* Fixed bug where player armor and weapon damage were much lower than intended.

notes.title: v0.1.19
notes.content:
Changes:
* Ctrl-right-click on dead enemy to automatically loot everything.
* New key binds: select party members, select minions, select target of target, and loot all.
* Tab-selection of target can be rebound to other keys.
* Bonus weapon damage is now derived from Attack Power instead of Strength.
* Many melee abilities now base their damage on Attack Power instead of weapon damage.
* Revised the formula used to calculate favor gained from sacrificing items. UI now shows how much favor will be gained.
* Kick and Counterspell don't need to wait for the global cooldown to finish, but will trigger it.
* Increased damage of most offensive spells with a cast time.
* Ticks from buffs and debuffs don't happen immediately.
* Expandable stash.
Issues fixed:
* Fixed issue with experimental controller support.
* Healing Potions and Mana Potions now have vendor values.
* Players are only eligible for group loot if they were in the group at the time of the kill.

notes.title: v0.1.18
notes.content:
Changes:
* Reduced cast time of Curse of Corruption.
* Increased critical strike chance bonus from Blessing of War.
* Paladins can now use staves (including fishing rods).
* XP from group kills is now calculated based on maximum character level instead of average.
* You now only get XP from group kills if you contributed to it.
* Witch minions don't count towards the instance minion limit.
* Lesser demons have slightly larger teeth.
* Experimental controller input support (needs to be enabled in options).

Issues fixed:
* Blessing of the Defender and Curse of Inaction now work like intended.
* Fixed bug where Judgement casting time wasn't affected by Relentless Assault.
* Minion tool tips based on weapon damage now show correct values.
* Fixed bug where tool tips would show the wrong mana costs.
* Witch minions no longer die when you change instance or log in.
* Fixed bug where you'd spawn outside of instance when reconnecting.
* Fixed some typos and other small bugs.

notes.title: v0.1.17
notes.content:
Changes:
* Two new unlockable classes: witch and paladin.
* A new type of shrine that is bound to the most popular deity of the previous day.
* You can now create up to 8 characters per account.

notes.title: v0.1.16
notes.content:
Issues fixed:
* Fixed some client crashes.

notes.title: v0.1.15
notes.content:
Issues fixed:
* It's no longer possible to select a UI scaling option that makes the game unusable.
* Fixed some server stability issues.
* Dead minions that are too far away will be dismissed automatically.

notes.title: v0.1.14
notes.content:
Changes:
* Added click-to-move with an option to disable it.
* You can now follow other players.
* UI scaling option.
* Wisdom now adds bonus spell damage and healing.
* Lair of Zuthyg now resets every 12 hours.
* Updated /who and guild UIs.
* Quest items can now be picked up by all party members with quest.
* Option to show floating aura events.
Issues fixed:
* Healing Conduit now works like intended.
* Number of action bars is now remembered.
* Banner of Command now also affects caster when not in a party.
* Fixed a couple of client crashes.
* Turned a couple of client crashes into error messages.
* Ties on the achievement point scoreboard goes to the player who got it first.
* All dungeon boss loot now binds on pickup like intended.
* Lake of Fire only damages other players if both caster and target have PVP enabled.
